newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Tamadam revises rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Tamadam revises rights issue.

text.p: Tamadam Bonded Warehouse Bhd said on Monday it had revised the ratio and price of its rights issue from two-for-five to one-for-two and the price from 4.00 ringgit to 4.35 ringgit.
In a statement, the company said the proposed rights issue, originally announced on December 26, 1996 involves the issue of 10.89 million shares.

Out of the total proceeds of 47.37 million from the rights issue, 24 million ringgit will be used for the construction of a new warehouse in Port Klang near Kuala Lumpur, 22.572 million ringgit will be used for repayment of bank borrowings and the balance of 800,000 ringgit will be used for the rights issue expenses.

Approval for the proposed rights issue is also required from the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, while application to the Securities Commission is expected to be made in three months time, the company said.
